A new power struggle may be unfolding within the Tata Group, one of India's most respected business empires. With Noel Tata at the centre of the Tata Trusts leadership and questions surrounding Jimmy Tata, N. Chandrasekaran, and the future of Tata Sons, the spotlight is once again on the group's internal power dynamics.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
